# Contract: Module Translations

**Feature**: `019-localization-language-packs` | **Binding modules**: `gp-module/`, `modules/build.sh`, `operator/internal/oci`, `operator/internal/controller` (GameTemplate), `api/internal/handlers/modules.go` | **Status**: Binding

## 1. Ids (derived from module.yaml / template.yaml; generated by `gp-module i18n extract`)

| Id | Source field |
|---|---|
| `module.displayName`, `module.summary` | `module.yaml` |
| `template.displayName`, `template.description` | `template.yaml spec` |
| `versions.<id>.displayName` | version picker entries |
| `config.<key>.displayName`, `config.<key>.description`, `config.<key>.options.<value>` | configuration fields |
| `actions.<id>.displayName`, `actions.<id>.description`, `actions.<id>.group` | console actions |
| `actions.<id>.params.<name>.displayName`, `….description`, `….options.<value>` | action params |
| `mods.<volume>.displayName` | mod volumes |
| `metrics.<id>.displayName` | metrics |

Ids use the YAML identifiers verbatim (dots inside identifiers are escaped as `~`). Commands, regexes, env values and images are never translatable.

## 2. Packaging

- Each `locales/<tag>.json` is one OCI layer, media type `application/vnd.gameplane.module.locale.v1+json`, title annotation `locales/<tag>.json`. `en.json` is not pushed (the template is the default text).
- Pushed by `modules/build.sh` and `gp-module package`; covered by the existing cosign manifest signature (FR-033). Bundles without locale layers stay valid.

## 3. Operator

On GameTemplate install/upgrade: validate each locale layer with `i18n/pack` against ids extracted from the bundled template. Valid entries → ConfigMap `<template>-locales` (`data["<tag>.json"]`, owner ref → GameTemplate). Invalid entries dropped; condition `LocalesValid=False`, reason `InvalidEntries`, Warning event listing up to 20 `tag:id: problem` lines. Module install never fails because of locales (FR-034).

## 4. API

`GET /api/v1/modules/{name}/locales/{tag}` (mounted in the existing `/modules` route group, `api/internal/handlers/modules.go`) → `200 {"<id>": "<compiled message>"}`; resolution `tag` → base language → `{}`. Same RBAC as `GET /api/v1/modules/{name}`. `404` only when the module does not exist.

## 5. Dashboard

Create-server and server-settings screens look up module ids in the fetched locale map, fall back to the template's own text (FR-032).
